subject: Really aligning to the right tip labels of different lengths, with both align=T and hjust=1

messages.author: 6d1670c958c89073
messages.subject: Really aligning to the right tip labels of different lengths, with both align=T and hjust=1
parts:
Hi there,

It seems it is not possible to really right-align the text of the labels of the tips when these labels have different text lengths. I don't want them at the tips, but all aligned, so I use align=T inside my call to geom_tiplab(). I also want the text itself to be right-aligned, so I use hjust=1, a.k.a hjust="right". But then I get the tree displayed in the attached SVG file: the labels are all right_aligned, ok, but I would like to move them a bit to the right so that they are not overlapping the end of the branch. Therefore I would like to further use a nudge_x=... argument, but it's impossible because it conflicts with something else:

Error in geom_segment2(mapping = segment_mapping, linetype = linetype,  :
  formal argument "nudge_x" matched by multiple actual arguments

I am running R version 3.5.0, with ggplot2 3.0.0 and ggtree 1.12.7. Can someone help me, please? Many thanks!
